page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs with a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.8 GB of memory per core, and has a 35 MB L3 cache. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external storage solutions, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1438.99, while the multi-core score reaches 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read-only speed of 2133.36 GB/sec and an uncached large-block read speed of 108.89 GB/sec. In database operations, the instance achieves 34.78 million operations per second for Redis SET commands and a Passmark database score of 14249.04. For language model tasks, it processes 1841.39 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M model, dropping to 56.94 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

Given its dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon cores and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge offers a stable resource profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without GPU acceleration. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are externalized, which is a tradeoff for data-heavy local processing but suitable for decoupled architectures. This instance is well suited for multi-threaded applications, database operations, static web serving, and moderate-scale CPU-based machine learning inference.
